note: Booster text for build-boosters.mjs. name / description are the game's own English strings (looked up in game_names_ko.json for the Korean); description null = the game table has no Korean for it. value fills the game's #VALUE placeholder (from the wiki page). detail = the wiki page's concrete facts, written for this site; test-boosters.mjs checks every number in it against the wiki page.

hellpod-space-optimization.name: Hellpod Space Optimization
hellpod-space-optimization.description: Helldivers come out of the Hellpod fully stocked on Ammo, Grenades and Stims.

detail.ko: 첫 투입과 증원 모두에 적용됩니다. 가득 채우는 개수는 입은 방어구에 따라 다릅니다.
detail.en: Works on the first drop and on every reinforcement. How much you carry depends on your armor.

vitality-enhancement.name: Vitality Enhancement
vitality-enhancement.description: Provides minor damage reduction from all sources for all Helldivers.

detail.ko: 받는 피해가 10% 줄고 팔다리 부상도 덜 입습니다.
detail.en: Damage taken drops by 10% and limb injuries happen less often.

uav-recon-booster.name: UAV Recon Booster
uav-recon-booster.description: Increases all Helldivers' effective radar range.

detail.ko: 레이더 범위가 약 50% 넓어집니다. 넓어진 범위는 각자의 미니맵에만 보입니다.
detail.en: Radar range grows by about 50%. The wider scan shows only on your own minimap.

stamina-enhancement.name: Stamina Enhancement
stamina-enhancement.description: Increases all Helldivers' stamina capacity and recovery.

detail.ko: 달리기·슬라이딩의 스태미나 소모가 22.5% 줄고 회복 속도가 30% 빨라집니다.
detail.en: Sprinting and sliding drain 22.5% less stamina, and stamina recovers 30% faster.

muscle-enhancement.name: Muscle Enhancement
muscle-enhancement.description: Allows Helldivers to traverse difficult terrain with ease.

detail.ko: 모래 폭풍·눈보라·물·눈·진흙·풀숲·철조망에서 느려지는 정도와 산성 공격의 감속을 줄입니다. 맨 모래·오르막·기어오르기·흔들림에는 효과가 없습니다.
detail.en: Less slowdown in sandstorms, blizzards, water, snow, mud, foliage and barbed wire, and from acid attacks. No effect on plain sand, slopes, climbing or tremors.

increased-reinforcement-budget.name: Increased Reinforcement Budget
increased-reinforcement-budget.description: Increases the number of available reinforcements.

detail.en: Starting reinforcements grow by 1 per Helldiver (5 to 6 when solo).

flexible-reinforcement-budget.name: Flexible Reinforcement Budget
flexible-reinforcement-budget.description: Reduces time until new reinforcements are granted once they've been depleted.

detail.ko: 증원을 다 쓴 뒤 새 증원이 생기는 시간이 25% 줄어 2:00이 1:30이 됩니다.
detail.en: Once reinforcements run out, new ones arrive 25% sooner: 2:00 becomes 1:30.

localization-confusion.name: Localization Confusion
localization-confusion.description: Increases the time between enemy encounters.

detail.ko: 벌레굴·드롭십 같은 적 증원 호출 사이의 간격이 길어집니다.
detail.en: Enemy reinforcement calls such as bug breaches and dropships come further apart.

expert-extraction-pilot.name: Expert Extraction Pilot
expert-extraction-pilot.description: Lowers the time it takes for the extraction shuttle to reach the extraction beacon.

detail.ko: 수송선 도착 시간이 30% 줄어 2:00이 1:24가 됩니다. 복잡한 스트라타젬 좌표 조건에서는 3:00이 2:06이 됩니다.
detail.en: The shuttle arrives 30% sooner: 2:00 becomes 1:24, or 3:00 becomes 2:06 under Complex Stratagem Plotting.

motivational-shocks.name: Motivational Shocks
motivational-shocks.description: Allows all Helldivers to recover faster after being slowed by an attack, such as acid. Does not mitigate "area effects," such as EMS strikes.

experimental-infusion.name: EXPERIMENTAL INFUSION
experimental-infusion.description: In addition to restoring health, stims temporarily increase movement speed and damage reduction.

detail.ko: 각성제를 쓰면 잠시 이동 속도가 10% 빨라지고 받는 피해가 10% 더 줄어듭니다. 대신 조준선 흔들림이 25% 커집니다.
detail.en: Stims briefly add 10% movement speed and 10% damage resistance, but aiming sway grows by 25%.

firebomb-hellpods.name: Firebomb Hellpods
firebomb-hellpods.description: Lines all Hellpods with volatile incendiaries that detonate upon impact, igniting any units in vicinity of the drop site.

detail.ko: 사람이 탄 포드와 장비 포드 모두 착지할 때 폭발·화염 피해를 줍니다. 아군도 다치니 첫 투하 때 동료에게 알리세요.
detail.en: Every Hellpod, manned or not, deals blast and fire damage on landing. It hurts friends too, so warn your squad before the first drop.

dead-sprint.name: Dead Sprint
dead-sprint.description: Allows Helldivers to keep sprinting even when they are out of stamina, draining their health instead.

armed-resupply-pods.name: Armed Resupply Pods
armed-resupply-pods.description: Mounts a modified AR-23 Liberator to all resupply pods, allowing them to double as automatic turrets.

detail.ko: 재보급 포드에 리버레이터 페네트레이터(AR-23P)가 달려 30m 안의 적을 자동으로 쏩니다. 탄이 떨어지거나 포드가 부서지면 멈춥니다.
detail.en: Each resupply pod carries an AR-23P Liberator Penetrator that shoots enemies within 30 m until it runs dry or the pod is destroyed.

detail.ko: 대형 적이 죽을 때 일반 샘플을 떨어뜨릴 때가 있습니다. 임무당 최대 10개입니다.
detail.en: Large enemies sometimes drop common samples when they die, up to 10 per mission.

sample-scanner.name: Sample Scanner
sample-scanner.description: Gives Helldivers a <c=#COLOR>#VALUE</c> chance to retrieve twice the samples on sample pickup.

detail.en: Works on samples of every rarity.

stun-pods.name: STUN PODS
stun-pods.description: Exposes Hellpod wiring upon surface contact, stunning any units in the vicinity of the drop site.

concealed-insertion.name: Concealed Insertion
concealed-insertion.description: Equips Hellpods to deploy smokescreens on impact, obscuring Helldiver deployment.

detail.ko: 사람이 탄 포드와 장비 포드 모두 착지할 때 잠깐 연막을 뿜습니다.
detail.en: Every Hellpod, manned or not, puts out a short burst of smoke on landing.

surplus-eat-allocation.name: Surplus EAT Allocation
surplus-eat-allocation.description: Grants two free uses of the Expendable Anti-Tank (EAT) Stratagem per mission; enough to grant a full squad one single-use rocket launcher each, provided squad members employ the proper equipment distribution protocol.

detail.ko: 임무마다 EAT-17을 2번 무료로 부를 수 있어 4명이 1개씩 가질 수 있습니다.
detail.en: Two free EAT-17 call-ins per mission, enough for one launcher each for 4 Helldivers.

integrated-extinguishers.name: Integrated Extinguishers
integrated-extinguishers.description: Equips Helldiver uniforms with form-fitting, automated, rapid-response fire suppression systems. Significantly reduces the time it takes to naturally extinguish flames without conducting ground-aided smothering maneuvers.

detail.ko: 몸에 붙은 불이 저절로 빨리 꺼져서 다이빙하거나 엎드리지 않아도 됩니다.
detail.en: Flames on you go out quickly on their own, so you no longer have to dive or go prone.
